name: avalara-classification
title: Avalara Classification
summary: Classify, validate & verify HS codes and access tariff compliance data for cross-border trade
description: Avalara Classification MCP server helps AI agents classify, validate, and verify Harmonized System (HS) codes and access tariff compliance content for cross-border trade. It supports import/export workflows that need consistent product classification and duty-related compliance data.

useCases.name: HS code classification
useCases.description: Classify products into Harmonized System codes so agents can prepare customs documentation and duty estimates for cross-border shipments.

useCases.name: HS code validation and verification
useCases.description: Validate or verify proposed HS codes against Avalara classification content to reduce misclassification risk before import or export.

useCases.name: Tariff compliance lookups
useCases.description: Access tariff and trade compliance data tied to product classification for e-commerce and logistics decisioning.

avalaraClassificationOauth.description: Authenticate with Avalara using OAuth2 authorization code flow.
